thig6.3:1.1: daharā tuvaṃ rūpavatī ahaṃ pi daharo yuvā | pañcaṅgikena turiyena ehi Kheme ramāmase. || ||
thig6.3:2.1: iminā pūtikāyena āturena pabhaṅgunā | addiyāmi harāyāmi kāmataṇhā samūhatā. || ||
thig6.3:3.1: sattisūlūpamā kāmā khandhānaṃ adhikuṭṭanā | yaṃ tvaṃ kāmaratiṃ brūsi arati dāni sā mamaṃ. || ||
thig6.3:4.1: sabbattha vihatā nandi tamokkhandho padālito | evaṃ jānāhi pāpima nihato tvam asi antaka. || ||
thig6.3:5.1: nakkhattāni namassantā aggiṃ paricaraṃ vane || yathābhuccaṃ ajānantā bālā suddhiṃ amaññatha. || ||
thig6.3:6.1: ahañ ca kho namassantī sambuddhaṃ purisuttamaṃ | parimuttā sabbadukkhehi satthu sāsanakārikā. || || Khemā. ||
